svg.aria-label: OPEN VOCABULARY: A label is a text, so a new label needs no training. One more embedding, nothing else. TOPIC TREE: Every label has a place: hut -> building -> building and structure. RUNS ON CPU: ONNX Runtime, about 35 ms per image on an M-series Mac. No GPU, no external API
